anchors.description: Horizontal distance between the centers of the two turned wood posts that flank the metal headboard at the head of the bed, i.e. the outer width of the bed frame.
anchors.visible_evidence: Two tall turned wood posts with ball finials are fully visible, one at each end of the dark ornate metal headboard standing against the back wall under the window; both posts are upright and clearly separate the headboard from the wall on either side.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Full (1.37 m) vs queen (1.52 m) width cannot be resolved; a twin (0.97 m) is unlikely given the two-pillow layout and the headboard proportions, but not excluded. I clicked post centers, so post diameter adds a small outward bias.

anchors.description: Long dimension of the small blue rectangular box lying on the duvet beside the pillows (face of a standard US facial-tissue box).
anchors.visible_evidence: Blue rectangular box with a light oval panel on its top face, lying on the plaid duvet just below the pillows; its long edge runs roughly left-right across the bedding and spans about 53 px, with the short edge much shorter.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Most likely a US facial-tissue box (long side 0.21-0.24 m); could also be a small book or a wipes package (0.18-0.22 m). Identity affects length by roughly +/-0.03 m, covered by the interval.
